verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry and leaderboard with a companion CLI, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack contains no OpenAPI or equivalent API spec. A community member explicitly asks the site to 'make a rest API', which suggests none exists. The agentskills.io SKILL.md format specification describes a file format, not a downloadable API spec, so it earns no credit.
